reviews.title: Greatest Quiet Fan there is!
reviews.comment: In my Opinion the Noctua NF-A12x25 G2 are the Greatest, Performance, Quiet fans on the Market.  They have the power to cool the most powerful components currently on the market while staying some of the quietest fans you can purchase. They come with vibration Pads for the front and rear of the fans, Rubber Mounting Studs, Cable extensions, and a Y-Splitter making for simple installation without having to purchase anything additional.  They have only two negative issues In my opinion.  The are not available in Reverse Blade configuration, and they do not have an RGB option.  So if your looking for awesome Performance, and an ultra quiet PC system look no further.
reviews.author: Joshua Schubert

reviews.title: Great Performance and Quality and Super Quiet.
reviews.comment: Excellent airflow, super quiet. I had a PC that was loud and annoying, replaced all the fans with these, now it barely makes a sound.
reviews.author: K.A.

reviews.title: Great fan, quiet and good airflow, nice accessories
reviews.comment: I got this fan to replace the stock 120mm fan on an AIO water cooling system.  The design of the Noctua G2 fan is perfect for this application, since it's design helps with static pressure and keeping airflow up through a radiator without adding a ton of noise.  At 1800rpm this fan is very slightly louder than the fan it replaced that ran at only 1500rpm, however Noctua included a short fan speed/noise reduction cable extension that would drop the top speed of the fan down closer to 1500rpm which would also reduce noise.  In operation with the computer fully loaded with a stress test, this fan dropped my cpu temperatures by about 5C which is really good for just a fan swap. The fan came with a few really nice accessories too.  Each corner of the fan has a little rubber mounting insert to reduce vibration noise, and Noctua also included a full size rubber seal that goes around the entire fan to help it seal up better against water cooling radiators.  I used this seal, and installation was very simple.  All fan cables were nicely sleeved to improve the looks of the wiring.  The packaging also included the fan speed/noise reducing cable extension, a plain fan cable extension, and a fan cable extension with Y-splitter.  There were a few other items as well, such as mounting screws and some rubber mounting pins that could be used instead of screws when mounting to a metal case as an intake or exhaust fan.  All in all it was a very nice accessory package and it at least partially explains the premium cost of the fan. The only real drawback to this fan was the price - At the price I paid, it was actually more expensive than the entire AIO cooler I am using it on and that's not awesome.  Still, I wanted more cooling performance than I was getting with the original AIO fan and this Noctua G2 fan certainly performed up to my expectations.  Recommended!
reviews.author: Flensr

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.comment: Incredibly good air flow with barely any sounds. Installed it easily as an exhaust fan and it's working like a charm, temps look chilly. It includes some really handy additions like extension cables. Noctua makes incredibly good pc fans.

reviews.title: Best fans in the business... hands down!
reviews.comment: I always like looking for a deal... but these fans are a perfect example of paying for what you get.  These are little pricier than the competitors, but they move a ton of air, do it quietly and last forever.
